lines.en: label dormwarsfive12:
scene gothtimeyo1
: What do you mean you won’t wear the outfit I prepared for you? I always make the costumes for the second floor’s Dorm Wars contests.
lines.zh: : 你说你不肯穿我给你准备的衣服是什么意思？二楼宿舍战争的服装一向都是我做的。

lines.en: : If this is a DEI thing, I can assure you I am more than qualified to-
lines.zh: : 如果这是出于 DEI 的考虑，我可以向你保证，我的资历远不止——

lines.en: : Apologies, but I had no idea you were preparing any sort of costume for me. I was never informed of this.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，但我完全不知道你在为我准备任何服装。从来没有人通知过我。

lines.en: : Since when do I need to inform anyone to take their clothes off? I mean- to dress them in custom-tailored outfits?
lines.zh: : 我什么时候需要通知谁才能脱她们的衣服了？我是说——才能让她们穿上量身定制的服装？

lines.en: : Nice save.
lines.zh: : 补救得不错。

lines.en: : If it’s the undressing you want, I welcome you to accompany me to the dressing room. But I regret to inform you I’ve brought my own outfit to change into.
lines.zh: : 如果你想要的是脱衣服，欢迎你陪我去更衣室。不过很遗憾，我自己带了衣服来换。

lines.en: scene gothtimeyo2
: Since when do you own anything that could even apply to a goth fashion show? I’ve seen you wear two outfits in my life and they both just scream “coffee shop.”
lines.zh: : 你什么时候拥有过任何跟哥特时装赛沾得上边的东西？我这辈子就见你穿过两套衣服，而且都在尖叫「咖啡馆」。

lines.en: : They’re not mine, per se. They belong to my mother. And most of her clothing fits the theme of this contest quite perfectly.
lines.zh: : 严格来说，它们不是我的。它们属于我母亲。而她的大多数衣服都相当完美地契合这场比赛的主题。

lines.en: : Your mom isn’t actually Wakana, is she? Is that why you’ve had the hots for her this whole time? The incest kink? It’s all starting to make sense.
lines.zh: : 你妈妈该不会真的是 Wakana 吧？所以你才一直对她有想法？乱伦癖？一切都说得通了。

lines.en: : Unfortunately, she is not.
lines.zh: : 很遗憾，她不是。

lines.en: scene gothtimeyo3
: I’ll be perfectly fine on my own, though. Kyoko and I are about the same size now. I just hope I can do her justice.
lines.zh: : 不过我一个人完全没问题。Kyoko 和我现在的尺寸差不多。我只希望我能不辜负她。

lines.en: : She was quite beautiful before she was confined to a computer chair for the rest of time.
lines.zh: : 在她被永远禁锢在一把电脑椅上之前，她相当美丽。

lines.en: : She sounds very...relatable.
lines.zh: : 听起来很……有共鸣。

lines.en: : I take it you’ve also experienced inexplicable horrors then?
lines.zh: : 那么我猜，你也经历过无法言说的恐怖了？

lines.en: : Aye. I’m still playing Genshin Impact after five years and I do imagine there’s not much out there more horrifying than that.
lines.zh: : 是的。我都玩了五年《原神》了，我想象不出还有什么比那更恐怖。

lines.en: scene gothtimeyo4
: Are you ready, Ayane? I don’t think I’ve ever seen you wear anything goth-ish before. I’m kind of excited.
lines.zh: : 你准备好了吗，Ayane？我不记得见过你穿过任何哥特风的东西。我还挺兴奋的。

lines.en: : Sana — you do know you don’t have to wear that anymore, right? You can put your regular clothes back on now.

lines.en: : I know...I’m just tired after being up on stage for so long...so I think I’ll stay in this for a little while longer...
lines.zh: : 我知道……我只是上台那么久有点累……所以我想再穿一会儿……

lines.en: : I, for one, am proud of Sana’s new attitude. It means a lot to me as a fellow flatchester. Not like you’d understand, though.

lines.en: scene gothtimeyo5
: I am kind of nervous, though. But a little less about the outfit itself and more about the...question part.
lines.zh: : 不过我确实有点紧张。只是不太是紧张那套衣服本身，更多是紧张……提问环节。

lines.en: : Really? But you’re always so confident about literally everything. What could somebody ask you that would throw you off?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？可你明明对任何事都那么自信。有人能问出什么让你乱了阵脚的问题？

lines.en: : I...am confident. Yes. But I’m also friends with everyone in here. And I am extremely uncomfortable about how...open everyone suddenly is.
lines.zh: : 我……是很自信。是的。可我和这儿的每个人都是朋友。而我对大家突然都这么……开放，感到极度不适。

lines.en: : You mean about my dad and how we all want to fuck him?

lines.en: : I was binging it on the beach?
lines.zh: : 我是在海滩上刷的？

lines.en: : In your room in a cabin on the beach. You’re taking a break right now.
lines.zh: : 在海滩上一间小屋里你的房间里。你现在正在休息。

lines.en: : Got it.
lines.zh: : 明白了。

lines.en: : Noriko, what the fuck is this question?
lines.zh: : Noriko，这到底是什么鬼问题？

lines.en: : Hold on! I’m not done! So anyway, you’re on the beach. Crabs. Shovel. Netflix. But there’s an asteroid too! Way, way up in the clouds!
lines.zh: : 等一下！我还没说完！那么总之，你在海滩上。螃蟹。铲子。Netflix。但还有一颗小行星！在很高很高的云层里！

lines.en: : You’re the first person to spot it and you can feel in your heart of hearts that it’s going to destroy Japan.
lines.zh: : 你是第一个发现它的人，而你内心深处感觉到，它将会毁灭日本。

lines.en: : How do you save the world using only the objects at your disposal? Or how do you spend your final moments? Bonus points if you save the world.
lines.zh: : 你要如何仅用手边的东西拯救世界？或者你要如何度过最后的时光？如果拯救了世界可以加分。

lines.en: : Why were my questions not as complex as this one? Why do I have to scissor the teacher’s daughter?
lines.zh: : 为什么我的问题没有这么复杂？为什么我非得剪老师的女儿？

lines.en: : We can...scissor her together...
lines.zh: : 我们可以……一起剪她……

lines.en: : Please don’t.
: Hmm...quite the predicament. Quite...the predicament.
lines.zh: : 嗯……真是个难题。真是个……难题。

lines.en: scene gothtimeyo22
: Well, Noriko — I think I’d start by observing the crabs.
lines.zh: : 那么，Noriko——我想我会先观察那些螃蟹。

lines.en: : Animals are known to run from disaster, so if they make a break for the water, I may follow them and simply attempt to survive the apocalypse. I’m good at that.
lines.zh: : 众所周知，动物会从灾难中逃跑，所以如果它们往水里冲，我也许会跟着它们，只是努力在末日中活下来。我很擅长那个。

lines.en: : Next — I throw the shovel at the asteroid to try and knock it off course.
lines.zh: : 接下来——我把铲子扔向小行星，试着让它偏离轨道。

lines.en: : Roll to hit.
lines.zh: : 掷命中。

lines.en: : I don’t have dice.
lines.zh: : 我没有骰子。

lines.en: : You miss.
lines.zh: : 那你没中。

lines.en: : The asteroid is about to make contact!
lines.zh: : 小行星即将撞击！

lines.en: : I wake up and it was all a dream.
lines.zh: : 我一觉醒来，发现全是一场梦。

lines.en: : Beautiful. You win. Pack it up, girls. Contest is over.
lines.zh: : 漂亮。你赢了。收工吧，姑娘们。比赛结束。

lines.en: : At least let Nodoka go first! She’s the one on our team!
lines.zh: : 至少让 Nodoka 先来吧！她可是我们这边的！

lines.en: scene gothtimeyo23
: Question two — which will also be the last question since the first one took up too much time. How would you describe your ideal life?
lines.zh: : 问题二——也是最后一个问题，因为第一个太花时间了。你会如何描述你的理想生活？

lines.en: scene gothtimeyo24
: Like...where do I want to be in ten years?
lines.zh: : 比如……十年后我想在哪儿？

lines.en: : Ten...twenty...maybe even five for all we know! Just what would make you happiest and what would a perfect life really be to you?
lines.zh: : 十年……二十年……说不定五年也说不准！只要是什么能让你最幸福，以及对你来说完美的生活到底是什么样的？

lines.en: scene gothtimeyo25
: Well...I’ve kind of been saying it from the beginning.
lines.zh: : 嗯……其实我从一开始就一直在说。

lines.en: : I think a perfect life for me would be getting married and having as many babies as Sensei is willing to put inside of me.
lines.zh: : 我想，对我来说完美的生活，就是结婚，然后生下 Sensei 愿意放进我肚子里的那么多个宝宝。

lines.en: : Even if that number is zero?
lines.zh: : 就算那个数字是零？

lines.en: scene gothtimeyo26
: I figure I can talk him into one at least. A girl, hopefully. I’d want to see how he is with a daughter. I think it’d be really cute once the reluctance wears off.
lines.zh: : 我想我至少能说服他来一个。希望是个女孩。我想看看他和女儿相处是什么样子。我想等那股不情愿消退之后，一定会非常可爱。

lines.en: : Ahem.
lines.zh: : 咳咳。

lines.en: : Oh, scratch that. I know it’d be really cute because Ami is his daughter and Sensei loves Ami more than anything. So I’d want that for my daughter too.
lines.zh: : 哦，当我没说。我知道一定会非常可爱，因为 Ami 是他女儿，而 Sensei 爱 Ami 胜过一切。所以我也想要我的女儿拥有那个。

lines.en: : You’re off the hook. Still not gonna happen, though. If anyone is having Sensei’s babies, it’s me.
lines.zh: : 你过关了。不过那还是不会发生。如果有人要生下 Sensei 的孩子，那也只能是我。

lines.en: : We’ll see about that.
lines.zh: : 那我们就走着瞧。

lines.en: scene black
Ayane gets off the stage, winking at me before taking her place off to the side and allowing Nodoka to come up.
lines.zh: Ayane 走下舞台，朝我眨了眨眼，然后退到一旁，把位置让给 Nodoka。

lines.en: scene gothtimeyo27
Which she...certainly does. And not a second too late.
lines.zh: 而她……确实上来了。而且来得正是时候。

lines.en: : Well, hello everyone. I’m so sorry to have kept you waiting. I couldn’t get my little hat to stay on right.
lines.zh: : 那么，大家好。很抱歉让你们久等了。我这顶小帽子怎么都戴不正。

lines.en: : I want to wear the little hat.
lines.zh: : 我想戴那顶小帽子。

lines.en: : You want to wear every hat.
lines.zh: : 你每顶帽子都想戴。

lines.en: : Yet I never hat! Why no hat?! And why Nodoka hot when not supposed to be?!
lines.zh: : 可我一顶都没有！为什么没有帽子？！还有为什么 Nodoka 明明不该辣却这么辣？！

lines.en: : Nodoka...you...look stunning...
lines.zh: : Nodoka……你……美得惊人……

lines.en: scene gothtimeyo28
: Yet I am nothing compared to you, my sweet. This body is not fit to serve as an appetizer so long as you are on the menu.
lines.zh: : 但与你相比我什么都不是，我的甜心。只要你还在菜单上，这具身体连当开胃菜都不配。

lines.en: : What about me? Do me next.
lines.zh: : 那我呢？也夸夸我。

lines.en: scene gothtimeyo29
: Help me take these boots off later tonight and I will do whatever your little heart desires, Uta-chan.
lines.zh: : 今晚晚些时候帮我脱下这双靴子，我就满足你那颗小心肝的任何愿望，Uta-chan。

lines.en: : Can you just stay like this forever please?
lines.zh: : 你能不能永远保持这个样子？求你了。

lines.en: : I’ll think about it. Now, does anyone have any real questions for me? Maybe about shovels or...scissoring?
lines.zh: : 我会考虑的。那么，有人有什么真正的问题要问我吗？也许是关于铲子的，或者……剪刀式的？

lines.en: : Question one — if you had to fuck any girl in the class-
lines.zh: : 问题一——如果你必须和班上任何一个女生上床——

lines.en: scene gothtimeyo30
: Futaba, obviously. I’ve been dreaming about it for years, after all.
lines.zh: : 显然是 Futaba。毕竟我已经梦想了很多年。

lines.en: : I could have just told you that. I’m not happy about it, though.
lines.zh: : 你本来直接告诉我就行了。不过我对此并不高兴。

lines.en: : Okay, new question — where do I rank in the top twenty?
lines.zh: : 好，新问题——我在前二十里排第几？

lines.en: : The bottom ten. You want it too much. And where’s the fun in that?
lines.zh: : 后十名。你太想要了。那样有什么意思？

lines.en: : I think I’m just gonna kill myself. That seems to make the most sense for me right now.
lines.zh: : 我想我还是去死吧。那对我来说现在似乎最合理。

lines.en: : Do I get the next question then?
lines.zh: : 那下一个问题就归我了？

lines.en: : You get all of them from now on. I am dead.
lines.zh: : 从现在起全都归你。我死了。

lines.en: : Okay! Nodoka — you’re on a bus that’s moving backwards. And you just passed a convenience store staffed by large, animatronic cats.
lines.zh: : 好！Nodoka——你在一辆倒着开的巴士上。你刚经过一家由大型电子机械猫看店的便利店。

lines.en: : They need your help composing a song in order to revitalize the town. But the town is full of nephilim godkin with cauliflower ear and misophonia!
lines.zh: : 它们需要你帮忙谱一首曲子，来振兴这个小镇。但镇上全都是长着菜花耳、还有恐音症的拿非利人神裔！

lines.en: : What is your song about and what is it called?
lines.zh: : 你的歌是关于什么的，歌名叫什么？

lines.en: : It’s called “The Rotten Circle.” And it’s about what happens when a wish makes a wish.
lines.zh: : 叫《腐朽之环》。讲的是当愿望许下愿望时会发生什么。

lines.en: : How does that revitalize a town?
lines.zh: : 那怎么能振兴一个小镇？

lines.en: : It doesn’t — for I seek not to appease the children of gods but rather torment them the way they torment those I care for.
lines.zh: : 不能——因为我所求的不是取悦众神之子，而是像他们折磨我在乎的人那样折磨他们。

lines.en: : Uhh...rad! You pass as well!
lines.zh: : 呃……酷！你也过关！

lines.en: scene gothtimeyo31
: Which brings us to our final question — why did Yumi beat the shit out of you that one time?
lines.zh: : 那么来到我们的最后一个问题——为什么那次 Yumi 把你打得半死？

lines.en: : Noriko, I don’t think that’s something you should-
lines.zh: : Noriko，我觉得那不是你该——

lines.en: : No, I seriously need to know. I’ve gotten close enough to her by now to know that she’s the type to run away before actually hurting someone.
lines.zh: : 不，我真的需要知道。我和她已经够熟了，知道她是那种在真要伤人之前会先跑掉的类型。

lines.en: : So Yumi just waltzing across the room and punching Nodoka in the teeth is weird as hell to me. That’s not like her.
lines.zh: : 所以 Yumi 就这么大摇大摆地穿过房间、一拳打在 Nodoka 嘴上，对我来说奇怪得要命。那不像她。

lines.en: : That’s still not something you should ask her in front of everyone, though. It’s probably personal.
lines.zh: : 可那仍然不是你该当着所有人的面问的事。那大概是私事。

lines.en: : Yeah, because Nodoka would never try and drag personal information out of anyone up on stage. Right, Nodoka?
lines.zh: : 是啊，因为 Nodoka 从来不会在台上把别人的私事挖出来。对吧，Nodoka？

lines.en: : My my. It appears that the class may be turning against me. This outfit is even more cursed than I thought.
lines.zh: : 哎呀哎呀。看来全班都要跟我作对了。这身衣服比我想的还要受诅咒。

lines.en: : Nodoka...telling them would be a step in the right direction. It’s a chance to show everyone you do have a heart.
lines.zh: : Nodoka……告诉大家会是个正确的方向。那是个向大家展示你确实有心的机会。

lines.en: : It’s because I have a heart that happened at all. If I were the emotionless heathen I’m made out to be, I never would have pried in the first place.
lines.zh: : 正因为我有一颗心，那件事才会发生。如果我真像别人说的那样是个没有感情的异端，我一开始就不会去打探。

lines.en: : So...you did do something then. To provoke Yumi.
lines.zh: : 所以……你确实做了什么。为了激怒 Yumi。

lines.en: : Of course I did. It’s as you said — she’d never attack someone for no reason, would she?
lines.zh: : 我当然做了。正如你所说——她绝不会无缘无故攻击别人，不是吗？

lines.en: : You let her get expelled over that...
lines.zh: : 你就让她因为那件事被开除了……

lines.en: : I mean...she did beat Nodoka halfway to death. I think that warrants punishment, even if it was provoked.
lines.zh: : 我是说……她确实把 Nodoka 打得半死。我认为那值得受罚，就算是被人激怒的。

lines.en: : Provoked or not, Nodoka went out of her way to involve herself in my issues. Again. Because she thinks I can’t handle them myself. That’s what it was, right?
lines.zh: : 不管激怒与否，Nodoka 是特意插手我的破事的。又一次。因为她觉得我自己处理不了。就是这么回事，对吧？

lines.en: : It was a lot of things — but I regret none of them as they have led me here. And I am the closest to “happy” now that I have ever been.
lines.zh: : 那是很多因素叠加——但我一个都不后悔，因为它们把我带到了这里。而我现在比以往任何时候都更接近「幸福」。

lines.en: scene gothtimeyo32
: I suppose I may have gone slightly overboard, though. Whoopsie.
lines.zh: : 不过我想我也许稍微做得过火了一点。哎呀。

lines.en: : Hah...
lines.zh: : 哈啊……

lines.en: : It’s okay, Futaba. Nodoka is defective.
lines.zh: : 没事的，Futaba。Nodoka 是有缺陷的。

lines.en: : Yes...
lines.zh: : 是啊……

lines.en: : But I wish she’d go be defective somewhere else sometimes...
lines.zh: : 可有时候我真希望她能去别的地方缺陷……

lines.en: : She can promise you that she feels the same way.
lines.zh: : 她可以向你保证，她的感觉一模一样。

lines.en: scene black
: And that everything “wrong” she ever does can be traced back to that.
lines.zh: : 而且她做过的每一件「错」事，都能追溯到这一点上。

lines.en: scene gothtimeyo33
: Okay, Sensei! Despite this competition being slightly less sexy than the last one, we still saw some hot stuff and you still have to make a decision!
lines.zh: : 好了，Sensei！尽管这场比赛没有上一场那么色情，我们还是看到了一些火辣的东西，而你仍然要做出决定！

lines.en: : So, who’s it gonna be this time? The girl who escaped the apocalypse?! Or the girl who probably wants one?! Choose wisely!
lines.zh: : 那么，这次会是谁？是那个逃过末日的女孩？！还是那个大概想要末日的女孩？！慎重选择！

lines.en: menu:
Ayane
lines.zh: Ayane

lines.en: : I think I’m gonna have to go with Ayane.
lines.zh: : 我想我得选 Ayane。

lines.en: scene gothtimeyo34
if ayaneswimsuitwin == True:
: Yay! I’m actually in this one and not just the benefactor of sudden favoritism this time!
lines.zh: : 耶！这次我是真的参赛了，而不只是突然偏心的受益者！

lines.en: else:
: Yay! Babymaking is still a go! Time to make Ami an aunt!
lines.zh: : 耶！造人计划照常进行！是时候让 Ami 当上阿姨了！

lines.en: : Congratulations, Ayane. I’d stick my tongue down your throat if there were not another human between us right now.
lines.zh: : 恭喜，Ayane。如果不是这会儿我们中间还隔着一个人，我真想把舌头伸进你嘴里。

lines.en: : Thank you for being alive, Uta!
lines.zh: : 谢谢你活着，Uta！

lines.en: : Don’t mention it, Ayane!
lines.zh: : 不客气，Ayane！

lines.en: $ dormwars5floor1points += 1
$ ayanegothwin = True
Nodoka
lines.zh: Nodoka

lines.en: : I think I’m gonna have to go with Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 我想我得选 Nodoka。

lines.en: scene gothtimeyo35
: Wait — so I won every competition you got to choose for except the one I was actually in?! How does that work?!
lines.zh: : 等等——所以除了我真正参赛的那场之外，你参与的每一场都是我赢？！这到底是怎么回事？！

lines.en: : Yeah, what? I don’t get this at all.
lines.zh: : 是啊，什么？我完全搞不懂。

lines.en: : Perhaps he chose based on which girl he’d like to tie up and edge the most?
lines.zh: : 也许他是根据最想把哪个女孩绑起来、吊到欲仙欲死来选的？

lines.en: : No, because then he would have chosen me.
lines.zh: : 不，那样的话他会选我。

lines.en: : She’s not wrong.
lines.zh: : 她说得没错。

lines.en: scene gothtimeyo36
: What is this then? I don’t...get how I’m supposed to feel.
lines.zh: : 那这算什么？我不……知道我该怎么想。

lines.en: : Then just assume I’m doing it to tease you. That’s always a safe assumption if I repeatedly embarrass you.
lines.zh: : 那就当我是在逗你好了。如果我反复让你难堪，那永远是个安全的假设。

lines.en: : And how should I interpret you choosing me?
lines.zh: : 那我该如何理解你选了我？

lines.en: : Interpret it as you looking really fucking hot in that dress.
lines.zh: : 理解为你穿那条裙子他妈的辣爆了。

lines.en: : It shall be done. Thank you for your lust, father.
lines.zh: : 遵命。谢谢你的情欲，父亲。

lines.en: $ dormwars5floor2points += 1
$ nodokagothwin = True
Nodoka
lines.zh: Nodoka

lines.en: : I think I’m gonna have to go with Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 我想我得选 Nodoka。

lines.en: scene gothtimeyo37
: Oh?
: Only in terms of the outfits. I still prefer Ayane in virtually every other way. No offense.
lines.zh: : 只是在服装方面。其他几乎所有方面，我还是更喜欢 Ayane。无意冒犯。

lines.en: : None taken. I like you more when you abuse me anyway.
lines.zh: : 没有冒犯。反正我更喜欢你虐待我的时候。

lines.en: : Guess I can’t pull this style off after all...hahah.
lines.zh: : 看来我终究驾驭不了这个风格啊……哈哈哈。

lines.en: : No, you look great. I just think your...normal style suits you a little better while this is more up Nodoka’s alley.
lines.zh: : 不，你很好看。我只是觉得你……平常的风格更适合你，而这个更合 Nodoka 的路子。

lines.en: : What about me? Do you think I can pull off dark and gloomy?
lines.zh: : 那我呢？你觉得我能驾驭黑暗阴郁风吗？

lines.en: : Maybe visually. Attitude wise? Not a chance.
lines.zh: : 也许外表可以。性格上？不可能。

lines.en: : Yeah. That’s fair.
lines.zh: : 是啊。那倒也是。

lines.en: $ dormwars5floor2points += 1
$ nodokagothwin = True
scene black
: Anyway! With the conclusion of the goth girl glamour gala, we have officially completed all of the endorsed Dorm Wars competitions!
lines.zh: : 总之！随着哥特女孩魅力盛典落幕，我们已经正式完成了所有官方认可的宿舍战争比赛！

lines.en: : Will there be more behind the scenes? Who knows?! Probably Sensei! And the rest of us will just have to wait for our turn or...however this works! I’m still new to this stuff!
lines.zh: : 幕后还会有更多吗？谁知道呢？！大概 Sensei 知道！而我们其余的人只能等着轮到自己，或者……不管这到底怎么运作的！我对这些还是新手！

lines.en: : Uta! Come put your Chipotle order in. You’re the only one we’re still waiting on.
lines.zh: : Uta！快来点你的 Chipotle。就差你一个了。

lines.en: : Ah! Sorry! Bye, Sensei! Don’t forget me if bonus things happen! I might not compete, but I still want to watch!
lines.zh: : 啊！抱歉！再见，Sensei！如果有附加环节别忘了叫我！我也许不参赛，但我还是想看！

lines.en: $ dormwarsfive12 = True
jump dormwarsfive13
